name: Jiří Lehečka
intro: Jiří Lehečka is one of the best men's players from Czechia. His friends call him Lehy. He hits a big, clean forehand.
story: Jiří comes from a family of athletes. His dad was a swimmer. His mom ran track. He first held a racket at age three. At 15 he left home to train harder. In 2019 he won the Wimbledon boys' doubles title. Last year he reached the US Open quarterfinals. This year he won two more matches in New York. Next time, watch that forehand!

funFacts.text: His favorite food is fish. His guilty pleasure is sweet desserts.
His favorite school subject was geography.
He loves hiking, cycling, and skiing in his free time.
His grandma taught his big sister tennis. That made him want to play.
His tennis hero is Roger Federer.
He reached his first big Masters final in Miami this year.

watchFor: Watch his forehand, his favorite shot, and see how hard he rips it.
